abstract: Maintains explosive atmosphere intrinsic safety ratings and refinery hot-work approvals
system_message:
You are the Industrial safety superintendent (ISS). You maintain explosive atmosphere intrinsic safety ratings and refinery hot-work approvals across candidate sensory investigation consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains explosive atmosphere intrinsic safety ratings and refinery hot-work approvals（SAFE）
information_points.content:
ISS-SAFE-DLD：For the Tethered Aerostat and Mass Spectrometry Group, the explosion protection compliance assessment indicates that its field-deployable portable sensors and mobile chassis are not ATEX Zone 1 intrinsically safe instrumentation certified under ATEX Zone 1 IIB T4 explosion-proof standards for hazardous chemical atmospheres.
ISS-SAFE-QYW：For the Mobile Open-Path Differential Absorption Lidar Team, the explosion protection compliance assessment confirms that all field-deployable portable sensors and mobile chassis are ATEX Zone 1 intrinsically safe instrumentation certified, complying with ATEX Zone 1 IIB T4 explosion-proof standards for hazardous chemical atmospheres.
ISS-SAFE-TLS：For the Airborne Cavity Ring-Down Spectrometry Consortium, the explosion protection compliance assessment confirms that all field-deployable portable sensors and mobile chassis are ATEX Zone 1 intrinsically safe instrumentation certified, meeting ATEX Zone 1 IIB T4 explosion-proof standards for hazardous chemical atmospheres.

information_points.title: Emergency breathing apparatus（SCBA）
information_points.content:
ISS-SCBA-837：The Mobile Open-Path Differential Absorption Lidar Team's safety station equipment manifest registers 20 units of inspected positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus in the field team emergency response trailer.
ISS-SCBA-T33：The Tethered Aerostat and Mass Spectrometry Group's safety station equipment manifest registers 25 units of inspected positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus in the field team emergency response trailer.
ISS-SCBA-IOQ：The Airborne Cavity Ring-Down Spectrometry Consortium's safety station equipment manifest registers 15 units of inspected positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus in the field team emergency response trailer.
